premise: An explicit low-rank multiplicative entity-summary path before quantum preparation may help optimize relation selection, although frozen contextual H already includes entity markers. No additional information or quantum necessity is presumed.
novelty: Entity-conditioned attention/low-rank bilinear interactions are known; substantive new contribution and task-linked theory remain unresolved. This experiment screens utility, not novelty.
exact_conditional_prediction: For a fixed word state, alternate summaries a,a_prime change the added pre-tanh term by B diag(P h) P(a-a_prime). At B=0 this vanishes and native forward/shared-parameter gradients match; B gradients may differ. This known bilinear identity predicts computation, not benefit.

input.cache_order: Original SHA256(rmea-sample-v1:split:original_id) ascending; NOT current JSONL order
input.group: Unordered normalized entity-surface pair; metadata SHA256(str(original_id)) join to rawJSONL; original all4096 role arrays exact.
input.limitation: Same entity-surface-pair exclusion, not single-entity/document/semantic independence. All are original training examples; development only.

donors.construction: Exact R71 cohort_derangement rule, frozen fit/eval separately before labels; no minibatch reshuffle
donors.mismatch_train: Use the frozen donor entity summary for every forward, including fitting; evaluation donors come only from evaluation cohort.
donors.postfit: For the correct-summary trained ECQP only, additionally evaluate fixed mismatched summaries; a distribution-shift intervention, not semantic ground truth.

training.precision: float32; original stored H float16 cast per batch
training.order: Same seed-generated fit permutations for all9conditions; only fit indices in optimizer batches; no evaluation-based checkpoint selection.
training.initialization: One frozen native initial state; identical unchanged prepare/value/decoder/effect members copied to each condition; B=0. Native and quantum branches initially exact. Classical12 routing changes functions.
training.feature_scaling: None: native source interface, no fitted normalization, no new hyperparameter tuning.
training.checkpoint: Final epoch4 only; record every epoch descriptively, no best-epoch/condition/seed selection.
training.schedules: No early stopping, LR tuning, additional epochs/seeds, adaptive prefix extension or outcome-driven retries.

endpoints.primary: Fixed final-epoch official positive39 Macro-F1 difference: ecqp_quantum minus native_quantum
secondary: B norm and pre-tanh/circuit/attention/logit intervention effects
endpoints.classical: Compare entity-minus-square within each classical12 route; parameter matched, not matched compute/activecapacity or historical8Dcontrols.
endpoints.uncertainty: Descriptive paired group bootstrap over972 evaluation samples grouped into866 pairs;2000 fixed-seed resamples, retain all9conditions. Sampling interval is conditional on one fit/initialization and this development cohort, not training-seed or population replication.

decision.screen_positive: Primary Macro delta>0 and same sign for prespecified entity-vs-mismatch and entity-vs-square; report CE/accuracy harms and uncertainty without suppressing any control.
decision.mechanism_not_supported: Correct/mismatched postfit outputs numerically equal, no finite B gradient/update, or matches simple token/control explanation: no entity-specific/quantum claim.
decision.inconclusive: Primary interval crosses0, sparse/missing class support or ordinary short-screen null: no promotion and not whole-family rejection. No optional budget rescue.
decision.stop: Provenance/leakage/source/projection/numerics failure invalidates run. Primary Macro decrease>=.05 AND CE increase>=.1 is catastrophic for this frozen screen, not the entire trainable family.
decision.sensitivity: All40 class supports must be reported after label admission. If any of39 positives absent in fit/eval, Macro remains fixed denominator39 but rare-class/generalization interpretation is explicitly insufficient; no relabel/stratified reselection.
decision.no_formal_handoff: Screen is exploratory. Future full-data single-seed and replication require separate prospective contract, original formal handoff package and collaborator execution; no L1-L5 inheritance.

implementation_gates: Implement reviewed pinned prefix restorer and test multichunk/NPY/truncation/hash/reuse failures.
Revalidate original source/manifest/VersionId headers and exact prefix extraction; freeze actual output hashes before scientific fit.
Fix/verify P integrity under outer-module recursive state loading before integrating training.

Enforce task-only input paths excluding recovered valid/test; unit test ID/donor split isolation and zeroB shared-gradient parity; no full formal owner run.

execution.retention: If closed exploratory without continuation or unique model-analysis consumer: Git source/config/compact reports only; no new COS checkpoint/cache upload. Preserve existing bytes until separate cleanup.
